Package edu.cnu.mdi.splot.plot

Class PlotTicks

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.splot.plot.PlotTicks
public class PlotTicks extends Object
Draws the tick marks and tick labels on a PlotCanvas.

Tick layout

Ticks are drawn on both the top and bottom edges of the active plot area for the X axis, and on both the left and right edges for the Y axis, so that the plot is framed on all four sides. Major ticks carry value labels; minor ticks do not.

The number of interior major and minor ticks is configurable via the setNum* methods. Log-scale axes draw one major tick per decade plus minor ticks at 2–9 × the decade value; the numMajorTick* setting is not used in log mode.

Histogram mode

When the plot contains histogram data and setDrawBinValue(boolean) has been called with true, the X-axis labels show 1-based bin indices rather than raw data values. This mode is automatically suppressed if the underlying data is not a histogram.

Bar plot mode

When the plot is a bar plot, the X axis shows the name of each data curve centerd on its bar group rather than numeric tick values.

Graphics context

All drawing methods accept Graphics2D directly. No casts from Graphics are performed in this class. Callers that receive a Graphics from AWT (e.g. inside paintComponent) should cast once at the call site: 

 @Override
 protected void paintComponent(Graphics g) {
     super.paintComponent(g);
     plotTicks.draw((Graphics2D) g);
 }

    • setDrawBinValue

      public void setDrawBinValue(boolean drawBinVal)
      Enable or disable bin-index labels on the X axis.

      When enabled, X-axis labels show the 1-based histogram bin index instead of the raw data value. This setting is silently ignored if the plot does not contain histogram data.

      Parameters:
      drawBinVal - true to show bin indices; false to show raw values

    • draw

      public void draw(Graphics2D g2)
      Draw all tick marks and tick labels onto the plot canvas.

      This method draws major ticks (with labels) and then minor ticks (without labels) for both axes. Log-scale axes draw their own minor ticks (2–9 × decade) internally; the outer minor-tick loop is skipped for log axes.

      This method is a no-op if the active bounds or data world have not yet been established on the canvas.

      Parameters:
      g2 - the graphics context
